title: Test case specification
description: The test cases. Every case traces to one requirement in the requirements specification.

test_cases.description: At least one per requirement, plus negative cases (missing, deleted, malformed input).

id.description: TC-<requirement id>-<n>, e.g. TC-AC2-1, TC-NFR1-1. Unique.

level.description: operational: logs, metrics, traces, alerts and dashboards the change must produce.

runs_on.description: local: an automated test in the build record. stand: run by the stand tester, recorded in the test report. production: a check handed to the user.

negative.description: True for missing, deleted or malformed input cases.

preconditions.description: Data and state required. On the stand: records to seed through the real pipeline, or existing ones to reuse.

expected.description: The exact observable result. For quality requirements: the metric against its threshold.

test_cases.title: History lists every saved version newest first
History page shows the version used for shipping
test_cases.preconditions: seeded order O-1 with 3 versions, shipped after version 1

test_cases.title: History read is bounded
steps: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) the history query for it
test_cases.expected: at most 501 history rows read, through the history primary key

test_cases.title: Failure is traceable in logs
steps: request history for a malformed order id
search the stand's logs for the request's trace id
test_cases.expected: one error event carrying the order id and trace id
